about: 200 labelled sentences for measuring extraction quality against the blueprint's claim schema. Labels carry subject, predicate, object, polarity, modality and time — the FULL target, not what the current regex extractor can express.
limitations: SYNTHETIC. These sentences were authored for this dataset, not sampled from real transcripts. They are therefore biased toward what the author expected an extractor to find, and a system tuned against them can look better than it is.

The real dataset is CORRECTIONS-LIVE (Blueprint Part 11): every user correction is a labelled example produced by the person best qualified to judge. This is v1 and should be replaced, not defended, once corrections accumulate.
Single-sentence cases. Coreference across turns ('he', 'that project') is not represented and cannot be measured here.
One annotator. No inter-annotator agreement, so the labels carry no measured reliability.
